# Kone Consult

> Academic & Scientific Research Excellence Division of Kone Academy.

Kone Consult provides academic mentorship, statistical data analysis, thesis review, methodology design, and research synthesis for researchers, university students, and organizations.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Research Consulting](https://consult.codkon.com/#services) - Topic validation, statistical computing (Python, R, MATLAB), and thesis guidance.
- [Academic Publications & Blog](https://consult.codkon.com/blog) - Peer-reviewed methodology guides, LaTeX formatting tips, and data science breakthroughs.
- [Kone Pay Portal](https://consult.codkon.com/pay) - Secure client billing and direct research project payment gateway.
- [Sitemap](https://consult.codkon.com/sitemap) - Directory of all academic services, routes, and resources.

## Parent Ecosystem

- [Kone Academy Main Hub](https://www.koneacademy.io/) - Central technology and innovation collective.
